title: 1.7 N·m of club on one grip, 0.7 N·m held: lift it with two hands, stand it upright, lower its grip end into a bag cell
instruction: Put the golf club in the bag with both hands (the club puts 1.7 N·m on one grip; one hand holds 0.7 N·m): lower its grip end into a cell, let go, so it stands head up.
context: Every round of on-course golf ends with a 0.94 m, 0.42 kg iron going back into a divider bag, and held by the grip alone the club cannot be lifted steadily by one hand. NGF (2025) counts more than 29 million on-course golfers in the US and 48.1 million participants counting off-course play. A 7-iron's balance point is about 63 cm from the grip end (head 0.26 kg of 0.42 kg), so held level by the grip alone, 22 cm in, it needs about 1.7 N m of grip torque; a 35-40 N two-pad pinch holds about 0.6-0.7 N m (computed), and in the simulation the club turns in a one-hand grasp and ends on the floor. With the other hand on the shaft the two hands carry forces, not torque, and together raise the club upright, head up, and stand it on its grip end. Upright, its weight runs down the shaft, so one hand carries it over a cell of the divider top, lowers the grip end in and lets go. The bag is a free stand bag of the real 88.4 cm height.
setup: Frame: cm; origin midway between the arm bases, x forward, y left; heights above the floor. Two YAM arms (bases y +30.5 and -30.5) start in their ready pose beside a station table whose top is 75 cm above the floor. Iron: Titleist T150 7-iron, 37 in = 94 cm, about 0.42 kg (https://www.titleist.com/product/t150/560C.html), lies flat on the table along y, its grip end at (45, -32), head toward the left arm: rubber grip 27 cm long and 25 mm across, steel shaft 12 mm across, hosel and blade head 75 x 50 x 20 mm; balance point 63 cm from the grip end. Bag: Titleist Players S4 stand bag (https://www.titleist.com/product/players-s4/TB26SX4-001.html), standing free on the floor on a rubber mat, axis at (22, -80): top cuff 21.6 cm (8.5 in) across, 88.4 cm (34.8 in) tall so the rim is 13 cm above the table top, 2.18 kg (4.8 lb), 8 mm wall, two 1 cm dividers across the full depth giving four cells, and a 4 cm bottom; legs, strap and pockets left out; any cell counts. Friction on the grip: mu 1.0, 12.5 mm contact radius (estimates). Demo grip force 35 N per finger, under the YAM's about 40 N. Marks: tape on the floor at the bag's axis (22, -80), a tape mark 10 cm above the floor on the table leg, for the side video: a club's low end outside the bag and below that mark, with every part of both grippers 3 cm or more from it, has fallen. Cameras for a real trial: a side phone video of the bag top and rim, a top-down video, an end photo with a steel ruler held upright against the rim, a spirit level on the bag collar.
scoring: 1.0: grip end within 3 cm of bag bottom (end photo, ruler), head above rim, lean 35 deg max, bag tilt 15 max, grippers 3 cm clear (spacer), still 2 s. 0.67: grip end in bag, head above, tilt ok. 0.33: club 8 cm up. 0: none, or club fell outside (low end under 10 cm from floor, grippers 3 cm off).
run_limit: 1,800 steps (90 s at 20 Hz), about 2.8 times the demo
reset_notes: Reset: lay the iron flat on the table along y, grip end on the (45, -32) mark, head toward the left arm; stand the bag upright on its mark at (22, -80), rubber mat under it; about 20 seconds (estimate), nothing is consumed. Nothing is random.
fidelity: Approximate: the club is rigid primitives (grip and shaft cylinders, hosel, head box) at real length and mass with an estimated mass split; the bag is a rigid 16-sided shell with dividers at real size. Soft parts are left out: club speed is damped (8 per s, held or free; real slide time unmeasured) only while its low end is inside the bag, none in air. Grip friction, the 12.5 mm patch and the 0.6-0.7 N m pinch are estimates.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (1,800 steps, one session); demo: 1.0 (both hands, 632 steps); one hand: 0.0; lifted only: 0.33; hold in cell: 0.67; beside the bag: 0.0; toss 30 cm: 0.0; high: 0.0; no action: 0.0.
